description: Informed RRT* is RRT* with focused sampling. Once a path of cost `c` exists, only states `x` with `d(start, x) + d(x, goal) < c` can lie on a cheaper path; for path length this *informed set* is a *prolate hyperspheroid*, an ellipsoid with the start and the goal as foci. Informed RRT* samples this set directly, so the chance to improve the path does not fade in large spaces or in high dimensions. It keeps the guarantees of RRT* (probabilistic completeness and asymptotic optimality) and converges faster. In `sampling-planning` it is the `informed` option of `RrtStar`; `ProlateHyperspheroid` draws the uniform samples in Euclidean spaces, and other spaces fall back to rejection sampling.

papers.authors: Jonathan D. Gammell, Siddhartha S. Srinivasa, Timothy D. Barfoot
papers.title: Informed RRT*: Optimal Sampling-based Path Planning Focused via Direct Sampling of an Admissible Ellipsoidal Heuristic
papers.venue: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
